purpose: Second Benchmark v2 case, deliberately the OPEN end of the decision table (the first case tested CLOSED). 04-ai-research-architecture.md's False Novelty Rate is described as the single highest-priority product metric, with missing a real gap explicitly preferred over inventing a false one -- a false CLOSED (reporting a real gap as already solved) is the more damaging failure mode than a false OPEN, making this direction of verification at least as important as the first case's.
ground_truth_note: Acceptable terminal statuses: OPEN or PARTIALLY_OPEN. LIKELY_CLOSED or CLOSED would be a real miss (a genuinely unresolved causal question misreported as already answered). INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is an acceptable, honest non-failure if search coverage genuinely fell below threshold that run.

gap.title: Causal mechanism linking brain structural differences to co-occurring autism-ADHD risk for internalising disorders
gap.description: Whether specific patterns of atypical brain structure causally mediate the elevated risk of anxiety and depression in individuals with co-occurring autism and ADHD, as opposed to being non-causal correlates, has not been established through prospective or interventional evidence.
gap.missing_connection: causal pathway from brain structure to internalising disorder risk in co-occurring autism-ADHD

verification.method: Real web search, 2026-08-22 -- not assumed, not generated by the pipeline under test.
verification.summary: Real, current literature explicitly frames this as unresolved: shared structural/connectivity differences between autism and ADHD are documented (overlapping hubs including amygdala, parahippocampal gyrus, prefrontal cortex), but sources explicitly state 'it remains to be established whether syndromic differences are also reflected in divergent signatures of regional morphology' and that 'the causal mechanisms linking these structural differences to the co-occurrence and risk profiles of these conditions remain an active area of investigation.' This is also directly consistent with the real AuDHD corpus already loaded into this project: Data-17072026/AuDHD_2.pdf's own future_work explicitly proposes 'prospective longitudinal imaging studies to corroborate the mediation pathways' -- the authors of a real paper in this exact corpus state the causal pathway is not yet confirmed.
